'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[October 2021 Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan protests]]
**Clashes continue for the second day in [[Lahore]], [[Pakistan]], as the banned [[far-right]] [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremist]] [[political party]] [[Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan]] is demonstrating to pressure the [[government of Pakistan|government]] to release its leader [[Saad Hussain Rizvi]], who was arrested last year. Three protesters and two policemen were killed yesterday during the clashes and two protesters are killed today. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/23/deadly-clashes-as-banned-pakistan-party-continues-protest (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
**[[Islamic State|IS]] claims responsibility for the killing of 16 civilians during an assault at a village in [[Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Beni]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], three days ago. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/islamic-state-claims-responsibility-attack-congo-2021-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Uganda bombings]]
**One person is killed and three others injured when a bomb explodes in a bar in [[Kampala]], [[Uganda]]. Three suspected [[terrorist]]s are behind the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59028210 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Pacific hurricane season]]
**A [[tropical storm]] intensifies into [[Hurricane Rick (2021)|Hurricane Rick]] off [[Mexico]]'s [[Pacific Ocean|southern Pacific]] coast, and is expected to make landfall in the [[states of Mexico|states]] of [[Michoacán]] and [[Colima]]. [https://federalnewsnetwork.com/world-news/2021/10/rick-becomes-hurricane-off-mexicos-pacific-coast/ (AP via Federal News Network)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Namibia]]
***[[Namibia]] suspends the usage of the [[Russia]]n made [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine]] amid reports from [[South Africa]] that the vaccine increases risk of men contracting [[HIV]]. [https://www.wionews.com/world/namibia-suspends-use-of-russias-sputnik-v-vaccine-due-to-concerns-of-hiv-infection-423364 (WION)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/namibia-suspends-use-russian-covid-vaccine-after-safrica-flags-hiv-concerns-2021-10-23/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***The [[South Island]] reports its first community case of [[COVID-19]] since November 2020 in a man who travelled from [[Rotorua]] to [[Blenheim, New Zealand|Blenheim]] on October 21. [https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/health/coronavirus/126726176/the-wakeup-call-the-south-island-needed-covid19-in-blenheim-is-souths-first-community-case-since-2020 (''Stuff'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
***[[Russia]] reports a record for the fifth consecutive day of 1,075 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death]]s from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 229,528. The country also reports a record for the third consecutive day of 37,678 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8.2 million. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/russia-confirms-new-single-day-record-of-37678-covid-19-cases20211023143459 (ANI News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in South Korea]]
***The percentage of the population that is fully vaccinated in [[South Korea]] surpasses 70%, allowing the [[Government of South Korea|government]] to ease their COVID-19-related restrictions in November. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-says-over-70-of-its-population-is-fully-vaccinated (''The Straits Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Turkey]]
**[[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] orders the ambassadors of ten [[Western world|Western nations]] to be expelled from the country after their embassies called for the release of [[political prisoner]] [[Osman Kavala]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkeys-erdogan-orders-10-ambassadors-declared-persona-non-grata-2021-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Foreign relations of Hungary]], [[2022 Hungarian parliamentary election]]
**At a rally in central [[Budapest]], [[Prime Minister of Hungary|prime minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] accuses the [[United States]], the [[European Union]], and [[philanthropist]] [[George Soros]] of trying to meddle in the upcoming parliamentary elections. The accusations come as [[Opinion polling for the 2022 Hungarian parliamentary election|opinion poll]]s show Orbán's alliance [[Fidesz–KDNP]] and the rival [[United for Hungary|United Opposition]] polling neck-and-neck. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/23/hungarys-orban-accuses-eu-us-of-meddling-in-2022-election (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**The trial of [[Matteo Salvini]] opens in [[Palermo]], [[Italy]]. Salvini is accused of [[kidnapping]] and [[abuse of office]] when he ordered the detaining of 147 migrants at sea in August 2019, when he was serving as [[Ministry of the Interior (Italy)|minister of the interior]]. Salvini said that the decision was agreed upon with the [[government of Italy|government]], including then-[[Prime Minister of Italy|prime minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20211023-italy-s-former-interior-minister-salvini-stands-trial-on-migrant-kidnapping-charges (France 24)]
*[[Illegal drug trade in Colombia]]
**[[National Police of Colombia|Colombian police]] arrest [[Dario Antonio Úsuga]] (alias "Otoniel"), a leader of the [[Clan del Golfo]] [[Drug barons of Colombia|drug cartel]], in the town of [[Necoclí]]. Úsuga has been listed by authorities as one of the country's most-wanted [[drug trafficker]]s. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/colombia-most-wanted-drug-lord-otoniel-captured-gulf-clan-2264631 (AFP via CNA)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Scientists at the [[University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa]] announce the [[List of exoplanets discovered in 2021|discovery]] of 2M0437b, one of the youngest [[exoplanet|exoplanets]] ever found at a distant star. The [[exoplanet]] was discovered using the [[Subaru Telescope]] at [[Mauna Kea Observatories|the observatory]] on [[Mauna Kea]]. [https://scitechdaily.com/astronomers-discover-infant-planet-one-of-the-youngest-exoplanets-ever-observed/ (SciTech)]
